entries.displayName: NASA Earthdata Search, Discovery, and Transformation
entries.description: An MCP server for discovering and transforming NASA Earth science data. Its search tools query the Common Metadata Repository (CMR) for collections, granules, services, tools, variables, and citations, and NASA's Keyword Management System (KMS) for official GCMD vocabulary — enabling an agent to find datasets, confirm spatial and temporal coverage, and identify access methods. Its transformation tools connect to NASA Harmony to subset, reproject, reformat, and aggregate data server-side before download, so agents can deliver analysis-ready data tailored to a user's region, time range, variables, and output format without retrieving full granules. It also supports the Earth Observatory Natural Event Tracker (EONET) API for near-real-time natural event context.
